title: Perfect size for my toaster oven.
text: Perfect size for my toaster oven.. I orignially wanted these for my regular oven but didnt pay attention to the real size. They are smaller but then I got real excited because they fit in my toaster oven just perfect! I almost gave up looking for pans for that until now! They are sturdy and easy to wash.

product_metadata.title: MEHE Pizza Pan with Holes,Nonstick Carbon Steel Round Bakeware,Oven Pizza Baking Supplies for Home Kitchen,2-Piece (9&13inch)
features: 【WORKS WELL WITH ALL PIZZA TYPES】: 13-inch and 9-inch pizza pan with perforated surface for crisping crust
【CARBON STEEL CONSTRUCTION】: MEHE pizza crisper is constructed of 0.4mm carbon steel, providing even heat distribution and consistent baking results.
【NON-STICK COATING】: Nonstick interior and exterior for easy food release and cleanup

【NOT ONLY PIZZA】:You can also use this baking tray to bake bread, vegetable cake, cookies and chicken wings in the oven. You'd better put a layer of tin foil on it, which will make your chicken wings more delicious.Please try to avoid contact with acidic foods, do not touch the open flame
【DISHWASHER SAFE】: This pizza crisper is dishwasher and freezer safe.
description: ： The MEHE round pizza pan has smooth bottom that evenly heats the pizza, and the raised edges make the pizza easier to remove. The non-stick finish allows baked goods to release easily from the pan while making clean up a snap.Make your pizza complete and beautiful.The coating does not contain PEFE/PFOA/BPA, complies with FDA food grade standards.Clean, hygienic, non-toxic. This 13-inch and 9-inch pizza tray can be used with your pizza oven to make a delicious pizza.

: Pizza tray with around the high - edge design can effectively leak-proof and all around curling design to prevent scratching hand when baking . Using this pizza pan to make pizza makes it easy to be a happy pizza chef. Care instructions: before using your bakeware for the first time, wash and condition the bakeware by spreading one teaspoon of cooking oil over the interior with a clean cloth.  If slight surface marks or abrasions caused by the baking process are normal, they will not affect the performance of the non-stick coating. Please do not cut the pizza directly on the plate, otherwise it will cause severe scratches and the non-stick coating will come off.Baking temperature is not recommended to exceed 428 ℉

： This pizza pan is dishwasher safe, making clean up quick and easy. Hand-washing is recommended to extend the product life. You only need to add a little detergent to the water, and it will be as good as new after washing.
